---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves

Describe the problem or limitation this feature addresses.
> Example: "Currently, customers cannot filter items by preparation time, making it hard to order when in a hurry."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like.
> Example: "Add a 'Quick Bites (< 15 min)' filter toggle on the storefront page."

## Alternatives Considered

List any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Suggested Implementation (Optional)

If you have ideas on how to implement this technically (e.g., which model/view to change), share them here.

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, screenshots, or extra context here.
